model.description: Ahh Moments Caramel Crush Calm Rosin Chocolate delivers 100mg of pure relaxation in every indulgent bite. This indica-dominant edible combines rich, velvety chocolate with luxurious caramel notes, creating a decadent treat that melts stress away. Crafted with premium rosin extract, this chocolate offers a clean, full-spectrum experience that honors the plant's natural profile. Perfect for unwinding after a long day, Caramel Crush promotes calming, relaxed effects that soothe both body and mind. The smooth, sweet caramel flavor pairs beautifully with premium chocolate, making each dose a moment worth savoring. Whether you're seeking relief from tension or simply craving a peaceful evening, this 100mg chocolate edible transforms relaxation into an art form. Ahh Moments brings quality and consistency to every piece, ensuring your calm comes with incredible flavor.
